findings.detail: The dl_rate_fill warning is counting source-native no-rate unfunded commitments as missing-rate defects; funded direct-lending rows nearby carry disclosed rates.

rationale: False alarm. The raw schedule shows at least one representative flagged-style direct-lending unfunded commitment with dashes in the Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate columns, so a blank extracted interest_rate is source-faithful for that row rather than a data error. Nearby funded ACI rows in table 19 have disclosed rates of 9.80 percent and 9.30 percent, indicating the issue is the aggregate check scope over unfunded commitments, not a general inability to extract disclosed rates. The rate-type summary also totals the investments to 100.00 percent, so the low 67.1 percent fill metric is not independently a source-grounded defect.
